title: Do GPT Language Models Suffer From Split Personality Disorder? The Advent Of Substrate-Free Psychometrics

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Ten Item Personality Inventory (TIPI) to the GPT-3 language model in nine different languages and evaluating the variations and inconsistencies in the resulting Big Five personality trait scores using ANOVA and Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Models.
Analyzing the model's language-specific personality distributions to determine if it mimics culture-specific personality traits and norms associated with the language of the prompt.
